id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

mlPipe.description: pipe that the operation was called on.

run.description: run representing the ongoing {@link Workflow} execution.

runContext.description:
Additional context related to the run. For example {@link VllmPipe#process} stores the request ids generated by
the native vllm library in the key defined by {@VllmPipe#runContextKey}.

loggers.description:
Map of {@link MlLogger}s for {@link MlPipeline} and {@link MlModel} operations
Same as {@link MlOperationSpec#loggers} for the operation run.

trainJobRun.description:
reference to the train job run object that tracks the in-progress train job.
Populated iff the operation is an {@link MlDataOpName#TEMPLATE_TRAIN}.

title: A future-like interface that holds the execution status details of an Ml Operation (e.g. train) and retrieves the end result.
name: MlOperationRun
